notes.title: 2022/03/07 (version 3.0.1 major update)
notes.notes:
2022/03/07
(version 3.0.1 major update)
1. New: novice guidance
2. Add: optimize the operation of God bless skills, and add continuous God bless buttons and functions for plots and buildings.
3. Add: Veterans demobilization and removal function.
4. Add: set the options of adding lock frame and vertical synchronization, which improves the performance to a certain extent.
1. Adjustment: the loss of food spoilage is reduced, and the critical value of food spoilage trigger condition is raised.
2. Adjustment: set the upper limit of 50% for the maintenance and construction cost and time.
3. Adjustment: skill belief value consumption adjustment.
1. Optimization: the skill logic is optimized, and the skill description is displayed more comprehensively
2. Optimization: click and drag the plot, which will not cause delay.
3. Optimization: the pop-up effect of the suspension prompt box.
4. Optimization: the daily output of the top resource panel is the same as that of the suspended resource box.
1. Repair: incomplete display of creatures, arms and special lists in the upper right corner, and optimization of detail functions.
2. Fix: unknown active skill bug.
3. Fix: bug that can be trained beyond the maximum number of arms.
4. Fix: after the undead service is dissolved, it will get God people and veterans bug.

7. Fix: bug that construction enthusiasts can't achieve.
8. Fix: the battle is not over, but the game ends when the victory conditions are met.

notes.title: 2021-12-27| 2.0 Update Log
notes.notes:
2021/12/27
公告：
1.我们计划在1月份进行更新工作，主要包括bug修复、性能优化（卡顿问题）、操作简化、新手引导加强等。
2.对于部分新玩家反馈难度过大的问题，我们进行了适当调整（困难和无尽没有调整）。另外根据有很多玩家在无尽模式下能进行到十几、二十年的例子，推断问题不主要在难度或数值设定上，而是由于新手引导不行，令部分玩家对游戏理解不到位导致。
— — — — — — — — — — — — — — — —
修改：
1.调整：略微降低了简单、普通模式的难度。
2.调整：略微调高农田、渔场、林场升级后产出量。
3.调整：调低大部分兵种的训练时长。
